watches.name: Thule sportswatch
watches.description: Seiko NH35 automatic sportswatch Retro TV-dial titanium sportswatch. Titanium is lightweight, hypoallergenic and highly corrosion resistant. Go anywhere in style. Choose between fully brushed or fully bead blasted finish. Thyïlea , a retro TV-dial sportswatch Thyïlea or more commonly spelled Thule has become synonymous with any destination beyond the borders of the known world. The name on the dial is a reminder of no matter what the goal is, it is about the journey. The TV-dial shape is a throwback to the late 60’s, early 70’s when the TV had the world gathered around to see spaceflights and wonders across the globe. Watches of that vintage reflected the desire of the new and futuristic. The Thule brings back some of that nostalgia with an updated design and materials. Titanium for its light weight and durable properties. Hardened to HV1200 for scratch resistance and sapphire crystal to deck out the fumé sunburst dial. Inside you will find the Seiko NH35 automatic movement, a highly regarded movement from Japan, a true workhorse. Now also in fully bead blasted finish. “If you fancy a TV-dial watch, there’s no better option than the Aevig Thule.” Watchyawant ” You have to love and understand the history of TV-dial watches to appreciate what Yuen has created.” Fratello watches “if you’re sick of seeing the same trends recycled in the micro-brand space, you’ll find something to love here from Aevig.” Worn and Wound “As usual, Chip has cooked up a gorgeous new Aevig for us.” The Time Bum “This sunburst is just out of this world. watches.name: HULDRA automatic divewatch
watches.description: 5 colours with or without date. 10 options total. 42mm automatic retro divewatch. If you had to choose one male accessory it has to be the divewatch. Stylish from the beach to the boardroom. The Aevig Huldra, a vintage inspired divewatch reminiscent of the 60’s-70’s A compact barrel case measuring 42mm wide by just 46mm long paired with a modern jubilee for maximum comfort and style. Bracelet tapers from 22-18mm ending on an expansion clasp. Signature part of the Huldra’s appearance are the hexagonal applied indices based of the Aevig logo. Indices at 3, 6 and 9 are triangles to quickly get your bearings even in low light. For the date version the 6 ‘o clock index is partially replaced with a trapezium shaped window to show date with custom font. Framing the double domed AR (inside) coated sapphire you will find the 120 click uni-directional bezel. Bezel insert is filled with clear enamel then polished flush. This not only protects the lume underneath but does not have any gaps and does not come off. Bonus, it gives that Bakelite feel for that extra vintage vibe. Obviously the orange version does not have the enamel but a brushed stainless steel insert. The heart of the Huldra houses the Miyota 9015 automatic movement for the date version and a Miyota 90S5 for the no date version. A modern smooth running, high beat movement in many ways superior to the Swiss counterparts.

watches.name: Corvid automatik
watches.description: Limited time offer. Free NATO strap with your Corvid fieldwatch. Choose between Grey or Green NATO with corresponding or contrast hardware to complete your look. Corvid , a Bauhaus inspired fieldwatch. The distinct dial layout echoes the Bauhaus minimalism yet is easy to read at a glance. Inside you’ll find the Swiss made STP 1-11 automatic movement. Smooth runnning high-beat 28.800 with 26 jewels. Waterresistance is 200 meters with a screwdown crown to guard of water ingression. Dial choices are: matte black, full lume or a shot of champagne. Pair it with either a DLC black or brushed stainless* case and you have six possible combinations to choose from. *DLC is diamond like coating that is bonded to the steel to form a hard and scratch resistant shield. To round off the top, the Corvid is outfitted with a distortionfree double domed sapphire that is AR coated on the inside to minimize reflections for a clear view at the dial. watches.name: THOR manualwind dresswatch
watches.description: The Aevig Thor, a modern sized dress-watch with vintage flavour. At 40mm wide by 48mm long and 11m thick excluding the box sapphire on top it is slim enough to slip under a shirtcuff yet stand out discreetly. Bold and yet refined. [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””] The Aevig Thor, a modern sized dress-watch with vintage flavour. At 40mm wide by 48mm long and 11m thick excluding the box sapphire on top it is slim enough to slip under a shirtcuff yet stand out discreetly. Bold and yet refined. A custom handset and tactile crown sets the Thor apart from your typical dress-watch. Standard dauphine hands or pencilset could not contain as much lume or be this easy to read in any situation. The double fluted crown assures good grip to wind and set the manualwind movement inside. A first for Aevig is the see-through caseback to show off the detailed Miyota 8N33 manualwind movement. Hand winding a watch satisfies the connection to the marvel a mechanical watch is. About 40 turns winds up the movement completely for no less than 40 hours p0werreserve. Do not overwind for this movement does not have a slip like automatic winding movements do. The strap that accompanies the Thor is of premium calf leather, custom made in Germany. 20 to18mm almost straight cut with a slant tail for a bolder look to fit the theme. The strap is perforated at the back for added ventilation and comfort. Attention to detail and finish is carried out throughout even to the custom buckle with engraved logo and solid prong. “Not only newcomers will appreciate the Thor, as I’m sure it can also make a good impression on more experienced watch fans. It sure did here at Fratello HQ.” Fratello watches [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

watches.description: Specs : Dimensions: 40mm x 48mm Lugwidth: 20mm Thickness: 10mm Dial diameter: 35mm Movement: Ronda 703, quartz batterylife: max 6 years WR: 100 meters Crystal: domed mineral Lume: Superluminova C3 Strap: nato with signed buckle Price: €129 inc VAT VAT deducted at checkout for non EU customers Corvid MK2 a 100m WR field/flieger watch The quartz Corvid is a budget friendly version of the automatic Corvid. Small in price yet big in features. Inside is a precision Swiss made Ronda 703 quartz movement with astonishing batterylife up to 6 years. Just set it and forget it. The crystal is a domed mineral. The case is finished either in an attractive and durable black coating or completely brushed. We moved the crown from the traditional 3 ‘o clock position to the 9 ‘o clock position for comfort and restriction free movement of the wrist. The easy to read dial and handset features C3 Superluminova for high visibility come day or night. Want even more lume? Get the full lume dial. watches.name: VALKYR stainless sportswatch
watches.description: €371,07 ex VAT The 1970s, the spaceage just took off and the world was looking to the stars and beyond. The design of many objects during that time tried to capture this feeling of speed and innovation. The Valkyr automatic sportswatch is very much an example of that design philosophy. Gone is the traditional round case in favour of a blocky angular case with crisp edges, like an exotic supercar charged with energy ready to pounce. The sportswatch is the opposite of the 9-5 mentality and enters the realm of exitement and endless possibilities. 39mm compact automatic sportswatch. Valkyr , a retro styled sports watch The boxy shaped Valkyr is reminiscent of the 1970’s edgy futuristic styling. Sharp defined lines, bold clear colours, minimalist styling in a sporty package ready for action. Inside you’ll find the highly regarded high beat automatic Miyota 9015 movement. The matte dials are covered with a double domed, distortion free and anti reflection coated, sapphire crystal with a sharp beveled edge to boot. Around the crystal you’ll find a stainless bezel with a ceramic, scratch resistant, solid coloured insert in a contrasting colour or colour to match one of the dials. The precisely crafted indexes and handset are filled with BG-W9 lume that shines blue but looks white in normal lighting. “Stop what you’re doing and go buy this watch!!!” Worn and Wound “Retro-modern done right,” The Time Bum
